en-US.summary: Control HomeIQ Smart Home Energy Dashboard on Fire TV with Alexa voice.
examplePhrases: Alexa, show my energy report on HomeIQ
Alexa, ask HomeIQ what's my power usage today
Alexa, tell HomeIQ to turn on eco mode
en-US.name: HomeIQ Smart Home Assistant
en-US.description: Voice-enabled cross-device companion for the HomeIQ Fire TV application. Seamlessly bridges Alexa voice commands with your big-screen smart home dashboard to monitor energy, control 13 multi-room devices, and protect your family with Elder Care safety alerts.

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Open skill via Alexa simulator or Echo device. Deep link notifications are dispatched via AWS SNS / Firebase / Intent URI to the target Fire TV device running com.homeiq.firetv.
